title: Spring injection
prompt: Which dependency style does current Spring Boot guidance generally recommend?
choices: Looking up beans from a static context
explanation: Current Spring Boot documentation recommends constructor injection. A @RestController renders JSON by default when Jackson 3, the preferred JSON library in Spring Boot 4, is on the classpath. Jackson 2 support is deprecated.

misconceptions.explanation: Constructor injection makes required dependencies explicit and supports immutable fields.
misconceptions.retry: Explain what a class can guarantee immediately after construction.

retryPrompt: State the key distinction in your own words, then retry once.
